name: PDD-Extended-Bench
description:
PDD-Extended-Bench
	

Lead and corresponding author: Inderjeet Singh

	
		
		Dataset Summary
	


TFDP evaluation benchmark consisting of minimally contrastive sentence pairs with single-token masks for auditing disparities in autoregressive LLMs.
Two topic groups included in this release: Climate Misinformation and Gender Equality, each with masked and original variants constructed for single-token prediction probes.
Each record exposes ground-truth statements and masked counterparts… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Fujitsu/PDD-Extended-Bench.
evaluation_method: accuracy on masked-token prediction combined with disparity/fairness gap analyses between groups/topics
general_score_metric: masked-token prediction accuracy and measured prediction disparities (bias gap)
reputation: A focused auditing benchmark published by Fujitsu for measuring single-token bias/misinformation tendencies in autoregressive LLMs; used in fairness and safety auditing but not yet a broadly adopted standard.
